description.value: The Wildflower is a family-friendly, full-service restaurant inside the Fairmont Chateau Whistler, one of Whistler's landmark luxury mountain resorts at the base of Blackcomb Mountain. It serves locally inspired breakfast and dinner dishes alongside Whistler's most extensive wine list and a selection of regional craft beers. A touring cyclist finishing a ride in Whistler would find a welcoming, sit-down dining experience with a broad menu and a family-friendly atmosphere.
